description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a local Vancouver family business that started in 2006 and has grown to eight locations, all operating around the clock every day of the year. The Denman Street outpost offers a broad menu of fresh-baked pastries, artisan breads, sandwiches, cakes, donuts, and hot beverages, with dedicated vegan and gluten-free selections. Regularly voted among Vancouver's best bakeries, Breka has built its reputation entirely through word-of-mouth and is a fixture for both locals and visitors.
